_note: Oakbridge Community Church's full doctrinal statement. Adopting churches should replace with their own.

beliefs.title: Scripture
beliefs.statement: We believe the Bible is the inspired, authoritative word of God — sufficient for faith and life (2 Timothy 3:16-17).

beliefs.title: God
beliefs.statement: We believe in one God, eternally existing as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit (Matthew 28:19).

beliefs.title: Jesus Christ
beliefs.statement: We believe Jesus is fully God and fully man — born of a virgin, crucified for our sins, raised bodily from the dead, ascended to the Father, and one day returning to make all things new (1 Corinthians 15:3-4).

beliefs.title: The Holy Spirit
beliefs.statement: We believe the Holy Spirit indwells every believer at the moment of salvation, empowering us to grow in Christlikeness and serve the church.

beliefs.title: Salvation
beliefs.statement: We believe salvation is a gift of God, received by grace alone, through faith alone, in Christ alone (Ephesians 2:8-9).

beliefs.title: Humanity
beliefs.statement: We believe every person is made in the image of God and is loved by him — and that every person needs a Savior (Genesis 1:27; Romans 3:23).

beliefs.title: Marriage and Family
beliefs.statement: We believe marriage is a covenant between one man and one woman, a picture of Christ's love for the church, and the foundation of biblical family life (Ephesians 5:22-33).

beliefs.title: The Church
beliefs.statement: We believe the church is the body of Christ — a community called to worship God, love one another, and make disciples of all nations (Matthew 28:18-20).

beliefs.title: The Return of Christ
beliefs.statement: We believe Jesus will personally and bodily return to gather his people, judge the living and the dead, and make all things new (Revelation 21:1-5).
